# Varathambal Chockalingam Kalyana Mahal

> Premier wedding venue and grand banquet hall located in Madipakkam, Chennai. Accommodates 1000+ guests comfortably with 400+ dining seating, 11 air-conditioned rooms, centralized AC, hydraulic and passenger lifts, and dedicated car and bike parking with valet service.

## Overview
Varathambal Chockalingam Kalyana Mahal is an ideal venue for weddings, grand receptions, engagements, birthday parties, cultural ceremonies, and corporate gatherings. Located centrally in Madipakkam / Moovarasampettai in Chennai, it offers modern luxury, spacious ceremonial halls, and traditional hospitality.

## Core Venue Specifications
- **Main Hall Capacity:** 1000+ seating capacity (1500+ floating) with flexible, customizable arrangements.
- **Dining Hall Capacity:** Dedicated traditional dining hall with 400+ seating capacity.
- **Rooms Available:** 11 fully-furnished air-conditioned rooms, including dedicated bride and groom suites.
- **Air Conditioning:** 100% centralized air-conditioning covering the main hall, dining hall, rooms, corridors, and common areas.
- **Elevators:** Hydraulic service lift and passenger elevators serving all floors.
- **Parking:** Dedicated car parking and two-wheeler parking with valet driver service.
- **Security:** 24-hour full-facility CCTV surveillance with 4K cameras.
- **Kitchen & Catering:** On-site commercial kitchen facility available for caterers, with optional catering coordination.
- **Audio & Visual:** High-fidelity studio-grade sound and lighting systems, soothing background music across the venue.

## Special Packages
- **Brahmin Wedding Package:** Specialized 2½-day package tailored to traditional ritual schedules, catering coordination, and priest accommodation needs.
- **Receptions & Engagement Ceremonies:** Flexible morning, evening, and full-day booking slots.
- **Corporate & Social Gatherings:** Audio/visual setups, conference seating, and projector support.

## Key Amenities
- 100% Central Air Conditioning
- 11 Well-Appointed AC Rooms (Bride & Groom suites included)
- 400+ Seater Dining Hall
- Passenger Lift & Hydraulic Goods/Service Lift
- 24/7 Security & 4K CCTV Surveillance
- Car & Two-Wheeler Parking with Valet Support
- Multi-Gigabit High-Speed Wi-Fi
- Studio-Quality Audio-Visual Setup
- Generator / Full Power Backup
- Housekeeping & Maintenance Support

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What is the guest capacity?** Over 1000+ seated guests (1500+ floating) in the main marriage hall and 400+ dining seating.
- **Are rooms provided for family and guests?** Yes, 11 air-conditioned rooms are provided, including dedicated suites for bride and groom.
- **Is valet parking available?** Yes, both car and bike parking with courteous valet drivers are available.
- **Is elevator access available for senior citizens?** Yes, passenger and hydraulic service lifts serve all floors.
- **Can we bring our own caterers?** Yes, our fully equipped kitchen is available for your chosen catering team.
